checks.lead: Rufino del Carmen Arellanes Tamayo (Spanish pronunciation: [ruˈfino taˈmaʝo]; August 25, 1899 – June 24, 1991) was a Mexican painter of Zapotec heritage, born in Oaxaca de Juárez, Mexico.  Tamayo was active in the mid-20th century in Mexico and New York, painting figurative abstraction with surrealist influences.
